Subject: Possible NetSuite billing sync before launch?

Hi Priya,

Thanks for walking us through the CPQ sprint plan yesterday. The sales leadership team is excited about getting quote generation and approvals into Salesforce. One question came up after the session that I wanted to put on your radar.

Right now, once a quote is approved, our finance team still has to manually re-key quote totals and line information into NetSuite before billing can begin. Miguel asked whether we could also add a lightweight NetSuite billing sync before launch. The minimum useful version would probably send the customer, quote number, quote total, product lines, tax category, and billing schedule from Salesforce CPQ into NetSuite after final quote approval.

I understand this may not have been included in the original SOW. We are not trying to derail the August 1 go-live, but it would be valuable if there is a way to include a simple version without creating too much risk. Could Auctor please evaluate the level of effort and let us know whether this would require a change order or whether it could fit within the current project?

For now, please treat this as a request for evaluation rather than a formal approval. I still need to confirm budget and timing with Miguel and our IT lead, and I know we need to understand the impact on scope. If it cannot fit safely before launch, we can discuss making it a Phase 2 item after CPQ goes live.

Thanks,
Dana
